opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences based at a UK university or recognised research organisation; British citizens and EEA nationals eligible; must have a doctorate from a UK university; viva completed between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027; not holding a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year award for early‑career researchers to undertake an independent research project leading to a publishable output, strengthening research and teaching experience.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers with a long‑term appointment at a UK higher‑education institution or independent research organisation; working in the humanities or social sciences; early‑career, mid‑career or senior researchers eligible.
opportunities.summary: Supports UK‑based researchers to develop specialist skills (e.g., quantitative, data‑science, digital humanities, languages) through a 6‑12‑month award.

opportunities.title: APEX Awards

amount.raw: Applicants can apply for up to £200,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a permanent or fixed‑term position at a UK university or not‑for‑profit research organisation; must lead an interdisciplinary project across at least two Academy remits (Humanities/Social Sciences, Engineering, Natural Sciences).
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for established researchers to pursue interdisciplinary, curiosity‑driven research that bridges humanities, social sciences, engineering and natural sciences.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑career or mid‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences; must be based at a UK institution; no nationality restriction.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships hosted at DGAP Berlin to develop skills, networks and policy‑relevant research in areas such as security, Indo‑European relations, technology and AI, or European strategy‑making.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigators in the humanities or social sciences with an established role; must collaborate with international partners and demonstrate genuine interdisciplinary approach across SHAPE and STEM disciplines.
opportunities.summary: Two‑year awards for projects on mobilities that bring together UK researchers and international partners to produce interdisciplinary research spanning humanities, social sciences and STEM.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers of any career stage; must deliver a public‑engagement project in partnership with a GLAM or performing‑arts organisation.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative public‑engagement projects that bring humanities and social sciences research to wider audiences.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months.
opportunities.summary: Provides supplementary funding to support specific additional needs of applicants or award‑holders, such as equipment, caring costs, or assistance with application preparation.
